channel.title: PAGASA SLPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA SLPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:00 AM 10 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(Palapag, Laoang, Catubig, LasNavas, Mapanas, Gamay and Lapinig) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
